description: An older bearded, balding man with bare shoulders and a dark grey draped cloth sits on the edge of a wooden bed. He grips a younger man's wrist with one hand while the other hand rests near the patient's chest. The young man lies on pale linen with eyes closed. A clay jug, a bowl and a lit oil lamp sit on a low wooden stool, in a dim stone room with a small wall niche. The painting is dark and oil-like, with no visible text or frame.
